mentions.name: Philosophical task manager
mentions.description: A philosophical task manager based on notable philosophers such as Baudrillard and Foucault, built by reading their works, distilling their essence, and putting them through LLMs. It is currently a collection of prototypes whose design issues are being reconciled, conceived as a pragmatic tool for establishing the meaning of life.
mentions.source_excerpt: A philosophical task manager, based on notable philosophers such as Baudrillard, Foucault, etc.
mentions.author: Mathnerd314
